entries.claim: The plan explicitly omits “no release is published yet” from the `install.sh` header, contradicting AC6’s requirement that the CHANGELOG, design brief, and header “still say no release is published yet.”
entries.failure_scenario: Both plans can execute exactly as written and all listed verification commands can pass while the header lacks the required publication-status statement. Phase 6 would then be declared complete despite failing the locked AC6 documentation criterion.
